entries.text: How’s the project going?
entries.guidance: If useful, explore what’s working well or what’s been challenging. Neither is required.

entries.text: What’s your next step?
What would you like to try first?
How will you know whether that helped?
Stay curious. Listen before solving. Follow their words, not your assumptions.
Silence can be thinking time; do not diagnose it. Offer direct assistance when requested.
Passing, writing, drawing, speaking or pairs are legitimate choices. Let people own their next step.
